changePassphraseHelp: Verify your current passphrase before choosing a new one. The binder remains local and has no recovery service.
changeFailed: The current passphrase was not accepted or the new passphrases did not match.
eraseTitle: Erase this binder from this browser
eraseBody: This permanently deletes the encrypted binder stored by Continuity Binder in this browser profile. It does not delete printed copies, downloaded exports, or backups you saved elsewhere.
eraseBackupReminder: Before erasing, make an encrypted backup if you may need this binder again.
eraseFailed: The passphrase was not accepted or you did not type ERASE.
